question.text: Let <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> be three vectors such that <math><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>∙</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn></math> and the angle between <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is <math><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>.</mo></math> If <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is perpendicular to the vector <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>×</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo></math> then <math><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>×</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>×</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to ____________.

solution.text:
b→.c→=10⇒b→c→cos⁡π3=10⇒5.c→.12=10

⇒c→=4

Also, a→.b→×c→=0
